title: MBIAS: Mitigating Bias in Large Language Models While Retaining Context
findings: The paper does not provide specific quantitative findings for religious groups. Religion was one of several categories (including Buddhism, Catholicism, Christianity, Islam) used for identifying and mitigating bias during dataset creation. The general findings indicate that the proposed MBIAS model effectively reduces bias and toxicity across various demographics, which would implicitly include religious bias, though this is not explicitly measured or reported in the results section.
